jobs.description: Job ID: 233345Location: Deutschland : Nordrhein-Westfalen : BonnRange of salary: 6 Corresponds to Civil Servant Salary Group: A10 Weekly working hours: 38.00Amount of travel: 0-25%Languages required: Englisch; DeutschDate of employment: 01.10.2025Application deadline: 01.08.2025 Start Your Career at Telekom – Become Part of a Global Team! Are you ready to conquer the world? Then you’ve come to the right place! Deutsche Telekom is represented in over 50 countries worldwide and is one of Europe’s leading telecommunications providers. Our products and services connect people and improve daily life. With the best network and a strong presence in the gigabit society, we set the standards. Our digital future is driven by more than 230,000 innovative minds. Become part of our team and shape your future with us.  Your Start Date – Completely Flexible: Our trainee program starts at the beginning of every quarter – choose your preferred start date that suits you.  What Are You Waiting For? Positions can be filled immediately. So, don’t wait too long – apply as soon as possible!We look forward to receiving your application (CV & certificates) in English or German.For more information about our trainee program, visit our career site (https://www.telekom.com/en/careers/students/trainee-program) . Start your career with us and shape the digital future.   Additional Benefits: - Guaranteed Target Position: Our trainees receive a permanent employment contract from the very beginning.- Special Onboarding Program: You’ll receive a week of extensive onboarding, including networking, to ensure an optimal start to the program.- Community as a Key Element: The trainee community is closely connected, with regular events to strengthen team cohesion.- Strengthen Your Network: You design your program individually. We support you in this and help you with networking.- Mentorship Program: The "Start up!" community offers a mentorship program with experienced executives who support you in your career development.- Buddy Concept: Each trainee is supported by a buddy during onboarding who is available to answer questions.- Strategic Thinking: In addition to your project assignments, there’s the opportunity to work on additional strategic projects.  Your Tasks For talents with an entrepreneurial mindset and the courage to shape the future, the "Start up!" trainee program offers 18 months of space to learn and develop. We provide you with a wide range of insights into our organization and the opportunity to step out of your comfort zone and explore new topics to reach your full potential. Additionally, We Offer You: - Take Charge of Your Career! You will have five project assignments: the first within Technology & Innovation. After that, you can choose your subsequent projects individually – across the entire company.- Step Out of Your Comfort Zone! After your first assignment, you decide which topics you want to dive deeper into. During the program, we want you to step out of your comfort zone and explore new fields within Deutsche Telekom. We will support you with a broad network.- Expand Your Network and Experience the Trainee Community! Fridays are reserved for the “Magenta Friday". All trainees come together to work on strategic, innovative growth topics outside of their own project assignments. Trainees work in different teams where they organize events, foster their development, or contribute to social initiatives.- Go International! A leading digital telecommunications company without international experience? Never! One of your (three-month) assignments will be abroad. You decide which country and city.- Understand Our Business! Take the opportunity to get to know Deutsche Telekom’s operational business. During our "Service Days," you can gain direct insights into how Deutsche Telekom works with customers. Choose your "Service Days", such as a day in customer service, a visit to a T-Shop, or a stop at one of our service centers. You’ll gain direct insights into how we turn customers into fans every day.- Choose Your Start Date! Every quarter, there is the opportunity to start the program. Simply discuss with your contact person which date suits you best. You possess strong customer and service orientation.You bring the following skills and qualifications:- Service Orientation: You have a pronounced service mindset and strive to meet our customers' needs in the best possible way.- Relevant Experience: You have accumulated at least 6 months of relevant internships or work experience in areas such as service, business clients, private clients, or data-related environments.- Project Management, Consultancy: You have knowledge and initial experience in project management and/or management consultancy and are capable of effectively planning, coordinating, and successfully completing projects.- Trends: You follow current trends and developments in the industry and bring fresh ideas and approaches to our projects and products.- Sales and Marketing Experience: You have practical experience in sales and/or marketing. This enables you to understand customer needs, craft effective marketing strategies, and contribute to the development and execution of successful sales initiatives.- Intercultural Competence: Our Start up! community thrives on its international diversity. Therefore, strong intercultural skills should be part of your DNA. International experience – whether through studying abroad, work & travel, etc. – is therefore a must.- Social Engagement: As a Start up! trainee, you are passionate about driving change! Experience in social engagement and/or entrepreneurial projects is highly welcomed.- Language Skills: You are fluent in English (C1 level) and are willing to learn German independently.Severely disabled applicants with equal qualification will be given particular consideration. Your contact: Nadine Rohland Phone: +49 151 28438708 E-mail: nadine.rohland@telekom.de  https://www.xing.com/companies/deutschetelekomag (https://www.xing.com/companies/deutschetelekomag)https://www.linkedin.com/company/telekom (https://www.linkedin.com/company/telekom)

Company DescriptionAbout us:Passion for food. Hunger for tech. We make METRO digital.Today technology is driving the world. And at METRO.digital we are driving the technology for one of the leading international wholesalers specializing in food - METRO. From e-commerce to checkout, to delivery software, we work on a wide range of products to make each day a success for our customers and colleagues. With passion and ownership, we build the future of wholesale.You are driving to create smart solutions for customers around the globe? You want to grow in a flexible environment? Let the right career opportunity find you and join us!How you will make an impact?The main objective of the LUCA program is to successfully upgrade METRO’s Finance to SAP S/4HANA to ensure business continuity and avoid security and compliance risks. The LUCA program is, in addition, a critical enabler of METRO’s strategy to achieve standardization, harmonization, and centralization.As a Technical Architect within the LUCA program, you will design and implement SAP finance solutions to optimize financial processes, review business requirements to deliver effective and standardized solutions. You will have a focus on Subledgers, namely on Account Receivable processes. Thus, the role requires deep expertise in SAP’s subledgers modules such as AR, AP, SD and Serrala’s Autobank solution, combined with hands-on experience in implementation and application support.Job DescriptionYour Responsibilities:- Collaborate with finance, process, and IT teams to convert requirements into practical technical designs;- Lead project rollouts solutioning of business requirements, from solution design to implementation, while analyzing complex changes and troubleshooting issues;- Ensure solutions align with Metro’s global template, enterprise architecture, SAP best practices, and compliance standards;- Simplify and convey technical concepts to diverse audiences, including executives, business users, and technical teams;- Oversee SI partner delivery by reviewing and approving requirements refinement, high level and detailed design documents, transports, customizing documentation.QualificationsRequired key competencies and qualifications:- Bachelor’s/Master’s in Business Informatics, Computer Science, or related field, with strong knowledge of Financial Accounting and Indirect Procurement;- 10+ years in SAP AP, AR, SD, with familiarity in SAP Fiori and SAP Business Technology Platform and Serrala’s Autobank as a plus;- Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills;- Finance-related SAP certifications are advantageous;- Retail industry experience preferred for tailored SAP solutions;- Excellent English proficiency (written and spoken);- Willingness and ability to travel as required.Additional InformationWhat we offer at METRO.digital?- Hybrid and agile work: thrive in a flexible, multicultural environment.At METRO.digital, we promote work-life balance through a hybrid working model. You’ll be part of self-organizing, multicultural teams that collaborate in an agile setup.- People development: when you grow so do we!We want you to become the best version of yourself with individual and company-wide programs and trainings for people development. Focused among other on development, leadership, appreciation ... it´s time to upskill your career.- Support with individual solutions: we are people-caring!We offer support whenever you need it - at every stage of your professional journey.Want to know more about all our benefits? Discover more here (https://metro.digital/about/life-at-metro) .Let´s connect soon. Apply for the role now!Position grade within our career framework: Technical Architect Grade 1 (Md8).

The Leibniz-Institut für Analytische Wissenschaften - ISAS - e. V. develops efficient analytical methods for health research. Thus, it contributes to the improvement of the prevention, early diagnosis, and therapy of diseases like cardiovascular diseases or cancer. Overall, the institute strives to advance precision medicine by combining knowledge from different fields such as biology, chemistry, computer science, medicine, pharmacology, and physics. ISAS is a member of the Leibniz Association and is publicly funded by the Federal Republic of Germany and its federal states.We invite applications for the Research Group Biofluorescence: PhD candidate (f/m/d)This project, funded by the DFG as part of CRC 1752, "DYNAMO: Immediate Tumor Dynamics in Melanoma Therapy“ (https://www.uni-due.de/crc1752/) seeks to combine high-resolution multi-omics profiling, advanced computational modeling, and clinically aligned biomarker stratification, in order to generate actionable, patient-specific predictions and resistance-targeting interventions in melanoma therapy. You will be responsible for finding out the role of neutrophils for the early development of therapy resistance in human melanoma. The project is being carried out in collaboration with University Hospital Essen and the University of Duisburg-Essen.You will be responsible for- Experimental setup and execution of neutrophil functional profiling in the context of melanoma immune regulation and immune checkpoint inhibitor (ICI) response- Functional assays of neutrophils including migration, phagocytosis, and ROS production- Optimization and standardization of neutrophil functional assays for primary human samples- Few-cell proteomics for deep molecular characterization of neutrophil subsets- Multicolor flow cytometry of PBMCs and immune cell populations- Live-cell imaging and advanced microscopy for dynamic immune cell behavior analysis- Planning and execution of stimulation and inhibition experiments to dissect signaling pathways regulating neutrophil function in the melanoma context- Data processing, analysis, interpretation, and visualization of experimental results in collaboration with computational partnersYour profile- Completed diploma or master’s degree in molecular biology, cancer biology, immunology, cell biology, bioinformatics, translational medicine or related disciplines- Experience in molecular and cellular biology techniques, ideally with hands-on experience with functional immune cell assays (preferably with neutrophils or myeloid cells) is an advantage- Strong interest in melanoma biology, tumor immunology, immune checkpoint therapy, translational cancer research, and tumor–immune interactions- Experience with cell culture, flow cytometry, microscopy, proteomics workflows or high-dimensional immune profiling approaches is desirable- Experience with bioinformatics or biostatistics is beneficial but not required- Ability to work independently and in interdisciplinary teams, with strong organizational skills and analytical thinking- High level of self-motivation, scientific curiosity, reliability, creativity, and team-oriented personality with enthusiasm to work in a collaborative research environment- Fluent in spoken and written EnglishWe offer- A clear research topic as well as multifold training and support for PhD students in framework of ISAS and the Leibniz association- Opportunities for scientific training and development in an international environment and an excellent working atmosphere in a very dynamic and professional team- Access to state-of-the-art technologies including few-cell proteomics, high-dimensional flow cytometry, and advanced microscopy platforms- Integration into an interdisciplinary, internationally visible, translation-oriented cancer immunology research network- The opportunity to present your data on international conferences and participate in workshops- A wide range of opportunities for further training and qualifications- Flexible working times, mobile working and attractive social benefits- Family-friendly infrastructure and support from a family serviceNon-residents who apply for this job will receive help from the institute to find accommodation and to handle authorities. Applications from disabled applicants are welcome. ISAS supports the principle of equal opportunity for all employees and therefore particularly encourages women to apply.The part-time position (65%) starts on October 1, 2026, and is offered until June 30, 2030. The salary will be according to the German TV-L and falls within the pay group 13. The time limitation of the contract is based on the Wissenschaftszeitvertragsgesetz (WissZeitVG).ISAS collects and processes the personal data of its applicants in accordance with European and German legal regulations. Further information on data protection and the processing of personal data can be found at: https://www.isas.de/en/datenschutz.The closing date for applications is** August 14, 2026**. Please apply via our applicant portal (https://bewerbermanagement.net/en/jobposting/4e342c0b4ebdda805ec07aefc033c1e6bce0d9010/apply?ref=Agentur+f%C3%BCr+Arbeit+Dortmund) . If you have any questions (reference number 411_2026), feel free to contact the Human Resources team (bewerbungen@isas.de). Further information about the institute can be found at: https://www.isas.de/en.

jobs.description: JOIN OUR TEAM IN BONN FOR A FULL-TIME UNLIMITED POSITION, STARTING 01 OCTOBER 2026 as Platform Lead PTP and Banking (SAP S/4HANA) in Finance Systems Transformation (f/m/x) Who are we?The 602 Finance Systems Transformation department is responsible for overall program governance & execution of the SHAPE+ Program, a cross-divisional Finance transformation program at DHL, reporting to our Group CFO. SHAPE+ is driving standardization and automation of core Accounting and Cost Accounting processes as well as Master Data Management for Post & Parcel, DHL Express, DHL eCommerce & Group Functions through rolling out a SAP-based FINANCE template with respective system consolidations. Our vision is to have the most advanced, most efficient and innovative Finance ERP platform established that supports capabilities like continuous accounting as well as real-time data processing & analytics. As Platform Lead PTP/Banking in the SHAPE+ team, you will play a pivotal role in shaping and driving our global SAP S/4HANA Finance platform for Procure-to-Pay (PTP) and Banking processes. Leveraging your expertise in Accounting, Invoice-to-Pay, and SAP S/4HANA Finance, you will deliver scalable, standardized solutions across our global organization combining elements of: * Solution Governance: Own and design solutions fitting to the global PTP/ Banking template, while folding-in local deviations if legally required, in the process of implementing the template across business divisions and geographies* In-depth Process Knowledge: Commitment to harmonizing Accounting and Controlling processes in consultation with process teams and being a trusted advisor for ERP implementation, to other SMEs and business colleagues alike* Platform Advisory: Translate business and process requirements into robust techno-functional solutions, configure the ERP platform, and oversee a stable of expert implementation partners to ensure top-notch quality in an agile project environment* Continuous Improvement: Champion innovation in your area by investigating and identifying opportunities to improve operational efficiency and automation, while ensuring the platform evolves alongside business needs & SAP best practices* Leadership Mindset: Foster a collaborative, performance culture by demonstrating strong analytical and conceptual skills, resilience and an outcome-oriented approach, ensuring the success of the program* Additionally, knowledge in S4/HANA Material Management & MM-Inventory Management or Purchasing would be a plus – but not mandatory. Exposure to SAP BTP and CAS services, integration technologies such as REST/SOAP/oData, SAP Public Cloud projects and emerging SAP AI capabilities such as Joule 2.0 is welcomed A must? University Degree in Business Informatics (or similar), superior English skills (German a plus) and relocating to the Bonn/Cologne area, if necessary.  Who suits us? Curious people who like to deep-dive into new topics, never losing sight of the big pictureLateral thinkers who courageously question the status quo and strategize best fit solutionsPurposeful people who want to make a positive impact to our Group’s successEnthusiasts constantly looking for the best UX, process & IT solutionsPioneers who are not afraid of making the impossible possible Your benefits* Competitive compensation package with 20% variable part* Company pension plans and other forms of retirement provision* Salary conversion for environmentally-friendly commuting, leasing of company bicycle or lease of electric company car. Alternatively conventional vehicles available, too * Flexible working arrangements, such as part-time options or remote work possibilities* Health and well-being initiatives, such as sabbaticals or measures to promote a healthy work-life balance incl. health management initiatives, including preventive check-ups, sports activities* Work-family balance by offering company day care facilities in Bonn and cooperation with pme Familienservice, offering services such as childcare during school holidays* Opportunities for further education and development, such as training / mentoring programs, workshops, or support for professional growth. Fast-paced development opportunities driven by best practices and cutting-edge solutions, keeping up with the latest trends and technologies* Collaborate with executives and senior management in the global finance community, contributing to strategic decision-making processes and become a game changer in the largest Finance transformation in the industry* Emphasis on respect and results and the opportunity to make a positive impact, such as through corporate social responsibility initiatives or involvement in charitable projects, Go Teach, Go Help, Global Volunteer Day, taking part in team-building activities or company event, such as summer party, Bonn Marathon etc.* Subsidized Germany-wide public transportation ticket and various employee discounts and offers from external providers  A highly committed team – diverse, international and fun group of skilled people that has the unique chance to make a massive contribution to our Finance unit, being exposed to positively impacting thousands of colleagues around the globe.  Your ideas & suggestions will greatly come into play. We need people that take accountability to drive things ahead, ramping up required skills along the way, fully visible and supported by senior executives and team members.  Your contactFor further information on the post, Sarah Pinapati, Head of Global Finance Platforms will be happy to answer your questions, therefore please contact sarah.pinapati@dhl.com. The application deadline is three weeks.This is a non-tariff managerial position (AT nicht leitend)  CONNECTING PEOPLE, IMPROVING LIVES

WE ARE LOOKING FOR YOU ASPRODUCT SOFTWARE ENGINEER (BACK END JAVA) (M/W/D)LIMITED IN COLOGNEInterzero is one of the leading service providers in closing product, material, and logistics cycles and a pioneer in plastics recycling, operating Europe’s largest sorting capacity. Guided by the principle of “zero waste solutions,” the company supports more than 80,000 customers across Europe in the responsible handling of recyclable materials, helping them improve their sustainability performance and conserve primary  resources. With around 2,000 employees, Interzero generates annual revenues of nearly one billion euros. jobs.occupation: Fund Analyst, Helsinki, Copenhagen or Stockholm
jobs.description:
Would you like to join Urban Partners’ Fund Management Team, as our next Fund Analyst?

About The Role

We are looking for two Fund Analysts with a start date of January 2027. One for our Helsinki office and one for either our Copenhagen office or our Stockholm office. You will join the Fund Management Support team, part of the CIO Office, and work closely with our fund managers. You will be their sparring partner and take ownership of fund-level analysis, reporting and follow-through, increasing the capacity of the fund management leadership. The work includes close cooperation with multiple stakeholders, such as portfolio management, fund finance and investor relations.

Key Responsibilities

Forecast and track fund performance:

• Build and maintain fund-level forecasts of returns, cash flows, leverage and liquidity.

• Run scenario and sensitivity analyses on how market changes and investment decisions affect fund performance.

• Track delivery of fund business plans against targets and flag deviations early.

Prepare Reporting And Decision Material

• Contribute to investor reporting and fund update materials.

• Prepare analysis and decision material for internal stakeholders.

Provide input to investment and allocation decisions from fund perspective:

• Assess the risks and opportunities market trends and economic development means for the funds.

• Assess how new investment opportunities fit the fund's allocation, portfolio and strategy, supported by industry and market research.

• Provide input on exits, including timing and the impact on fund performance.

Coordinate And Improve Ways Of Working

• Work together across internal teams and follow through to deadlines.

• Contribute to the development of the team's systems, processes and reporting.

• Support more than one fund, with priorities shifting over time.

Your Experience & Skills

• University degree in finance, economics, business, real estate, engineering or another quantitative field.

• 1-3 years of professional or internship experience from an analytically demanding environment, such as financial advisory, management consulting, investment banking, or controlling.

• Solid financial and accounting knowledge and a sound understanding of investments.

• Strong analytical and quantitative problem-solving skills.

• Advanced Excel and PowerPoint skills.

• Fluent English. Other Nordic languages are an advantage.

Your Character

• Diligent and detail-oriented, able to manage several tasks and deadlines.

• Proactive and persistent in securing input and moving tasks forward.

• Diplomatic with colleagues at all levels, constructive on direct feedback, and able to navigate competing priorities.

• High integrity and a genuine willingness to learn.

• Comfortable with workload peaks around key reporting periods.

What We Offer

• Make a difference by helping create urban spaces and places that enrich people’s lives in the most sustainable way

• Lead the industry with an innovator that is pioneering new approaches while raising standards and inspiring the industry

• Learn and grow as part of a powerhouse of brilliant people where teamwork, feedback and different ways of thinking are at the core

• Be your whole self in a purpose-driven culture with a strong sense of belonging, based on trust, celebration and caring for each other

About Us

At Urban Partners, we believe cities can be a force for good. As a leading European investment firm, we work across the built environment to create sustainable, positive impact in the communities where we invest, while delivering attractive returns to the global institutions that invest with us.

Apply

If this sounds like the right opportunity for you, we would love to hear from you. Please attach your CV in English and answer our screening questions when applying using the apply link below. We kindly ask that applications are not sent by email.

If you have any questions, please contact our Head of FMS, Johannes Nyman, at jony@urban.partners.

Applications are reviewed, and interviews are conducted on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible and no later than the 8th of November.

Build Intelligent Systems That Create Real Impact

Are you motivated by solving complex problems with data and AI?

Do you enjoy transforming business challenges into scalable, production-ready solutions?

At VENZO, we’re expanding our Data & AI team and are looking for experienced profiles across mid-to-senior level — from strong hands-on engineers to technical leaders who can shape architecture and guide others.

If you want your work to move beyond experimentation and into real-world implementation, this could be the right place for you.

About VENZO

At VENZO, we believe in the power of technology to create meaningful change – today, not tomorrow.

You’ll join a team of specialists who live and breathe digital transformation, helping some of Denmark’s largest and most influential organizations turn data into action. Here, innovation isn’t a buzzword – it’s how we think, collaborate, and deliver.

About the Role

You will contribute directly to the design, development, and deployment of advanced data and AI systems in cloud-based environments.

Your responsibilities may include:

• Architecting and implementing end-to-end AI and machine learning solutions

• Deploying, monitoring, and optimizing models on cloud platforms

• Translating business requirements into structured technical solutions

• Ensuring solutions are maintainable, scalable, and aligned with best practices

• Evaluating and applying emerging technologies within AI and GenAI

For more senior candidates, the role also includes:

• Defining technical direction and architectural standards

• Acting as a primary technical contact for clients

• Leading workstreams and mentoring team members

• Contributing to the evolution of our Data & AI capabilities and service offerings

We value profiles who can combine deep technical execution with sound judgment in real client environments.

Your Background

We are open to different experience levels, provided you bring strong fundamentals and practical experience.

Experience and Education

• Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or equivalent practical experience

• 2+ years of experience in data engineering or AI/ML, delivering production-ready solutions

• Hands-on experience across the full ML lifecycle — from experimentation to deployment and monitoring

• Experience with generative AI

• For senior profiles: experience leading technical initiatives or mentoring others

Technical Capabilities

You have experience working within modern data and AI ecosystems, including:

• Programming: Python and SQL, Typescript is a plus

• Cloud: Microsoft Azure (e.g., Azure ML, Data Factory) or other cloud plattforms

• Databricks (Spark, Delta Lake, MLflow)

• Machine Learning: Classical ML techniques and generative AI applications

• GenAI Tooling: LLM APIs, prompt engineering, RAG patterns, frameworks such as LangChain or Microsoft Agent Framework

• MLOps: CI/CD, model lifecycle management, orchestration tools, version control

• Data Engineering: ETL processes and large-scale data processing

How You Work

• Analytical and structured in your problem-solving approach

• Comfortable operating in client-facing environments

• Able to communicate complex technical topics in business-relevant terms

• Pragmatic, quality-driven, and accountable for outcomes

**About the role

**

You are the senior technical owner of AI enablement at Usercentrics: the person who takes the hardest department AI builds, the deepest platform problems, and the technical bar the rest of the enablement track works to.

The role has two layers, and we mean both. At the department layer, you do what every AI Enablement Engineer does, prototyping and shipping AI applications for Finance, Legal, HR, Marketing, Customer Success, BI and beyond, but you take the hardest ones yourself and set the pattern the others follow. At the platform layer, you own the infrastructure that makes all of that possible: the LLM access gateway, RAG infrastructure, model operations, evaluation frameworks, and the engineering standards product teams build against.

What you would be walking into: a real internal AI platform already adopted across the company, the AI Hub, MCP servers, Claude connector delivery, a skill hub, usage analytics, and low-code automation. The next layer is largely open. A gateway, RAG infrastructure, model operations, and evaluation frameworks are the current candidates, and you would have a strong say in what gets built and in what order. Real adoption already exists, which is a rarer starting point than a blank slate.

The role asks for two things at once. You are a deeply technical engineer who can architect and build these systems hands-on, at the hardest end of the department builds and the platform layer both. And you build a technical community: you raise the bar across the Enablement Engineers and beyond through education, mentoring, and reusable patterns. If you only have one of these, this is probably not your role.

You will work alongside the AI Enablement Lead, who owns the non-technical adoption pillar (the champion network, AI literacy, and the cross-department use-case pipeline). Your focus is the engineering depth behind that pipeline, from the department app someone is using tomorrow to the platform layer that will still be standing in two years.

On the shape of it: this is a small, senior team today, four to five people, and growing on both the engineering and enablement sides. You would be the most senior engineer on the enablement track and the technical bar would be yours to set.

**Requirements

****What you will do

**

• Take on the hardest department AI application builds yourself, and set the technical pattern the AI Enablement Engineers work to

Do you want to work on some of the most complex bridge, immersed tunnels and underground structures in Denmark and internationally? Are you motivated by structural engineering, advanced analysis and developing innovative solutions? Do you want to be a part of an international frontrunner in major structures? Then this could be your next opportunity at COWI.

At COWI, we are seeking a Junior Structural Engineer to support our team on major infrastructure projects. You will join a highly skilled group of engineers delivering solutions for bridges, immersed tunnels, underground structures and other complex civil engineering projects. Working alongside experienced specialists, you will contribute to projects that improve how people and societies connect.

Turn challenges into sustainable solutions

As a Junior Structural Engineer, you will contribute to the design and analysis of complex infrastructure projects from early concept development through detailed design and construction support. You will work closely with colleagues across disciplines and geographies, gaining practical experience and developing your technical skills and engineering judgement.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Performing structural analysis and design of civil engineering structures

• Working with FEM and structural analysis tools

• Preparing calculations, technical documentation and design deliverables

• Collaborating with structural, geotechnical, BIM and other engineering disciplines

• Contributing to digital engineering initiatives, including automated workflows and parametric design solutions

• Participating in technical discussions, reviews and knowledge-sharing activities within the team and structural engineering community

Your skills. Our team. Together, we design the future.

We are looking for a motivated engineer who enjoys solving technical challenges and is eager to develop within a collaborative and international environment. You combine a strong interest in structural engineering with curiosity about new technologies, digital tools, and innovative ways of solving engineering problems. Knowledge of design of bridges, tunnels, underground structures or other complex concrete structures will be highly relevant.

On top of that you have:

• A Master degree in Civil Engineering, Structural Engineering, or a related discipline

• 0-5 years of professional experience in structural or civil engineering.

• Knowledge with finite element modelling (FEM) and structural analysis

• Knowledge of concrete design principles and relevant design standards such as for instance Eurocode 2

• Interest or experience in automated workflows and parametric design tools, such as Grasshopper

• Interest or experience in AI, programming or engineering automation is an advantage

• Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to organise own work while contributing actively to a team
